title: capability_announcements: 2 lib tests fail on merged main (IidMismatch + expiry verify)
description: Pre-existing on beads-worker-7 after sync with main (merge 6150dea23e, which carries 5e6390193d + eebl + tunnel-auth wiring). Repro: cargo test -p lichen-gateway --lib capability. (1) capability_announcements::tests::expiry_and_replay_semantics panics at :569 assert verify_announcement(&announcement, &pubkey, 1735689599, None).is_ok(). (2) capability_announcements::tests::vectors_decode_verify_and_encode fails at :460 case capability_egress_only: left Err(IidMismatch), right Ok(()). Likely another corpus/code divergence from the bad merges on main 2026-09-09 (cf. store-corruption bead project-LICHEN-worker6-rul5; capability vector regen 48c64007d1 + IID unflip commits). Fixer must reconcile the capability vector corpus against the verify code and the upstream AddrForKey addressing decision - do NOT weaken tests to pass. Note: unrelated to the route_hash 16-byte migration work (b7z9.93); filed discovered-from it because the failure surfaced while validating that bead.
